svg.aria-label: The contrast audit: fifteen gates with measured values against their floors — WCAG, APCA and CIEDE2000, including colour vision deficiency simulation
svg.text: dim fill is the run-up to the floor; full colour is the measured margin above it
— the knife-edge: an L* 58 red would fail here
CI re-runs the audit on every push, fails the build if any gate stops passing — and proves the audit itself can fail, against a deliberately broken theme.
